topics.title: Averages and range
topics.intro: An average is one number that sums up a whole set of data. Geographers, scientists and historians all use them, so this skill turns up everywhere.
topics.teach: Explain the difference between the mean and the median.
topics.talk: Ask her the mean of everyone’s ages at the table.
topics.hook: “Hey diddle diddle, the median’s the middle; you add and divide for the mean. The mode is the one that appears the most, and the range is the difference between.”

items.hook: Put the numbers in order first: then the middle, the most common and the spread are easy to see.

items.prompt: Which average is the middle value when the data is put in order?
items.explain: Median sounds like “medium”: the middle one.
items.hook: The median is the middle one, like the central reservation down the middle of a motorway.
items.example: Line your class up by height: the person standing in the middle has the median height.

items.prompt: Which average is the value that appears most often?
items.explain: Mode sounds like “most”: the most common value.
items.example: A shoe shop orders more of the mode, the size it sells most often.

items.prompt: To find the mean, you add up all the values and then…
items.answer: divide by how many there are
distractors: pick the one in the middle
items.explain: Mean = total ÷ number of values. It shares the total out equally.
items.hook: Mean = share it out fairly: add it all up, then share it between everyone.
items.example: Three friends with 2, 4 and 6 sweets who share them equally get 4 each: that is the mean.

items.prompt: What does the range of a set of data tell you?
items.answer: how spread out the data is
items.explain: Range = largest − smallest. A big range means the data is spread out.
items.hook: Range = biggest − smallest: how far the data ranges.
items.example: A week of temperatures from 12°C to 20°C has a range of 8°C.

items.explain: 7 appears twice; every other number appears once. (5.6 is the mean.)
items.hook: Mode = most: count which value turns up most often.

items.explain: With an even number of values there are two middle ones (6 and 8). The median is halfway between them: 7.
items.hook: Two middle values? Go halfway between them: add them and halve.
